Usage of /Users/you/.local/bin/finch:
  -box string
    	this box's name (default "Mac.localdomain")
  -config string
    	path to a finch.yml manifest; serves every ingress rule (one local service per app_path) over one process
  -forward-all
    	forward the WHOLE loopback host (every path), not just /mcp — for a website or any non-MCP HTTP app (single-service mode)
  -hub string
    	finch hub base URL (http[s]://…) (default "https://finchmcp.com")
  -state string
    	file that persists the per-box refresh credential so a restart needs no new ticket (default "/Users/you/.finch/agent.json")
  -ticket string
    	one-shot enrollment ticket from the dashboard (first run only; '-' reads it from stdin, or set FINCH_TICKET; later runs resume from --state)
  -upstream string
    	local MCP server base URL (default "http://127.0.0.1:8000")
